about_the_game:
This is a puzzle game that seamlessly blends 2D card mechanics with 3D scene transitions, offering a unique perspective-shifting gameplay experience. In this game, you will gather clues from immersive 3D environments and apply them to solve puzzles on a 2D card table. Meanwhile, your actions on the card table can also influence changes in the 3D world. Uncover related clues and piece together the unfolding story.

Oh, your senses have been separated. Now, use these unique senses to solve the puzzles:

  • Hand: Touch and pick up objects.

  • Eye: Observe objects.

  • Think: Analyze and examine objects.

These separated senses will become crucial elements in your puzzle-solving journey. Use them wisely!

Additionally, different cards have "fusion relationships." Combine them to explore more possibilities!

Soon, you will witness something even more incredible!

You can break free from the 2D perspective and step into the 3D scene! This game seamlessly shifts between 2D and 3D perspectives.

The objects in the 3D environment are interconnected with the cards on the 2D table.

  • Use 3D objects to alter the cards.

  • Use cards to change objects in the 3D world.

As the story progresses, you will uncover more about this enigmatic world.

"It" made everything disappear, yet the rain that night never ceased. Thus, I embarked on a journey to find the answers. Why did I become myself?

Switching between different ways of thinking is also a key strategy!

Different thoughts may lead to different outcomes.
